faqData.q: What is your primary area of expertise?
faqData.a: My three pillars are: Cybersecurity Engineering (threat intelligence, attack surface analysis, network security, CTFs), AI Engineering (LLMs, ML models, prompt engineering, FastAPI), and Full-Stack Development (React 19, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL). I study B.E. CSE (Cyber Security) at Chennai Institute of Technology.

faqData.q: What cybersecurity projects have you built?
faqData.a: Securox is my autonomous cyber risk intelligence platform with real-time attack surface monitoring, automated vulnerability assessment, and threat detection dashboards. I'm also Cisco Cybersecurity certified.

faqData.q: Are you available for freelance or collaboration projects?
faqData.a: Yes! I'm open to full-time roles, internships, freelance contracts, and technical collaborations — especially in cybersecurity, AI-driven systems, and full-stack engineering.

faqData.q: What is your competitive programming profile?
faqData.a: 500+ LeetCode problems solved with a peak contest rating of 1771 and a 118-day continuous coding streak. Strong in Data Structures, Algorithms, Dynamic Programming, and Graph Theory.

faqData.q: How can we start a project or partnership?
faqData.a: Reach out via the contact form or directly at nithishbharathwajn@gmail.com. I typically respond within 24 hours.
